summary: Origin Agritech furnished a Form 6-K confirming completion of a previously announced private placement of 2,000,000 ordinary shares at US$1.40 per share, for gross proceeds of US$2,800,000. The February 1, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreements with two individuals and one investment company settled in two installments, with the final payment received August 31, 2026 and shares issued September 16, 2026. Shares outstanding rose from 12,144,586 to 14,144,586. No warrants or placement agent fees; proceeds fund working capital, R&D, and debt repayment. This is a routine capital-raising disclosure, not a special situation.
